description: $2.00 once. Use when your client cannot sign an x402 payment on every call, or to pay many calls from one purchase: a prepaid key lt_... holding $2.00 of credit; send it as the X-API-Key header on POST /mcp (set it in your MCP client's config) or on any paid HTTP route and each call's price is deducted, so no x402 client is needed afterwards. Credit does not expire; the key is a bearer secret and activates when the payment settles. Each new payment buys a new key. Balance: GET /v1/keys/balance with the header. To try first: buy_trial_key ($0.10). No arguments.
